# STTS-Reentry — Training-Set Bootstrap (frozen projection)

Percentile bootstrap over 529 training satellites, B = 1000 replicates, seed 20260421. Projection (scaler/LDA/KMeans/basin/failure_cells) held frozen across replicates; only the set of training NORADs is resampled with replacement and the transition matrix is rebuilt from their cell sequences under the frozen projection.

Full-training transition matrix reconstruction vs frozen `markov_table.npz`: max abs difference 0.000e+00 (expect ≤ 1e-10).
